trigger.description: The merged protocol assumed exhaustive enumeration of all June 2026 SatNOGS norad_cat_id x ground_station pairs before deterministic hash ranking. Live source/schema verification established that the production observations endpoint uses fixed 25-record cursor pages. Official SatNOGS Network 1.134 source establishes default GET throttles of 60/hour anonymous and 240/hour authenticated. Exhaustively crawling the global month through the public anonymous API would be disproportionate and could burden the service.

superseded_population_discovery_rule.rule: Enumerate every June 2026 norad_cat_id x ground_station pair with at least 20 observations, rank every qualifying pair by SHA256('SATNOGS|' + norad_cat_id + '|' + ground_station), then apply the 32-pair and two-per-entity caps.
superseded_population_discovery_rule.reason_superseded: Public API pagination/throttling makes exhaustive global-month enumeration an unnecessarily burdensome acquisition strategy.

replacement_population_discovery_rule.purpose: Create a deterministic, prospectively defined candidate universe with bounded public-API traffic while preserving identifier-only selection and the original >=20-observation eligibility threshold and entity caps.
replacement_population_discovery_rule.stratum_definition: Ten non-overlapping three-day strata covering June 1-30, 2026 UTC.
replacement_population_discovery_rule.seed_window_algorithm: For stratum index i=0..9, compute SHA256('S8E-SEED|2026-06|' + i). Select day = stratum_start_day + digest_byte_0 mod stratum_day_count. Select one 10-minute UTC slot from 144 daily slots using big-endian digest bytes 1:3 mod 144.
replacement_population_discovery_rule.candidate_discovery_request_rule: Issue exactly one observations-API request per frozen seed window and use only the first cursor page. Persist only id, norad_cat_id, and ground_station for candidate discovery. start/end may be parsed only to confirm source-window membership/validity and are not emitted as endpoint evidence.
replacement_population_discovery_rule.candidate_pool: Deduplicate norad_cat_id x ground_station pairs observed on the ten frozen seed pages.
replacement_population_discovery_rule.qualification_rule: Traverse ranked candidates. Before a request, skip a candidate if admitting it would violate the maximum-two-per-NORAD or maximum-two-per-station cap. For each evaluated candidate, issue exactly one June-month query filtered by norad_cat_id and ground_station. The pair qualifies if the first response contains at least 20 records. Because the production page size is 25, a full 25-record first page is sufficient proof that the >=20 threshold is met; no timing values or later pages are needed for qualification.
replacement_population_discovery_rule.stop_rule: Stop immediately when 32 pairs have been admitted or when the 50-request cap is reached. If fewer than 32 pairs are admitted, freeze the incomplete result as observed and do not tune seed windows, thresholds, ranks, or caps in response.

claim_boundary_effect.selected_population_description: Prospectively defined deterministic rate-bounded SatNOGS trace-pair population discovered from ten frozen June seed windows and qualified only by identifier, count threshold, deterministic rank, and entity caps.
